spanish: Se haga pesado el servicio sobre los varones, y hagan en él, y no miren en palabras de mentira.
grammarChanges: Changed the verb government after 'miren' from 'a palabras' to 'en palabras' per the cited construct בְּדִבְרֵי; this is Spanish prepositional government only, not a meaning shift. The masculine 'él' for the 3fs suffix on בָהּ (referent הָעֲבֹדָה/servicio) was left as is, since the auditor confirmed it is grammatical gender smoothing on the same referent, not an error needing repair.
